scope: Independent read-only comparison of field/grid coverage, logical types, reference targets and default-detail-form declarations. No API or credential access.

summary.requirednessInterpretation: 39 present required fields are optional at base metadata level but mandatory on default detail forms. Do not report these as 39 blanket requiredness failures. API/persistence enforcement is unverified. The 40th expected required field is missing (Include All Facilities?).
summary.readOnlyInterpretation: 61 expected source/inverse receiving-screen read-only rows: 1 missing, 1 present with EditReadOnly=true (latest-feed flag), 59 present without base or explicit default-form read-only restriction. Runtime rights/control defaults remain unverified. Separate locale/state-dependent cases are listed.

positiveFindings: All 11 expected business objects are represented in the module after applying the one explicit BOMECS identity alias.
Every matched scalar has the expected simple logical type; Raw Payload Text is primitive-type compatible but capacity/binding remains unverified.
All 18 expected reference/inverse fields exist and their Type.Id identifies the correct local target object.
All 11 business-object SuperType values are null, consistent with no business inheritance.
BOMECS DisplayProperty is the Name field, as specified.
Two additional module objects are native Programs/Tags M:N maps and do not count as additional business objects.
All 67 present expected fields/grids have controls in their object default detail form.

All 39 present fields with unconditional requiredness have IsMandatory=true on their default detail form. The unexpected Include All Families? control is also mandatory, but is not credited as Include All Facilities?.
Part Revision Reference.Included in Latest Part Feed? explicitly has EditReadOnly=true on the default detail form despite base IsReadOnly=false.
keyValidationNuances: External ID is a legitimate business identity field on relevant objects and must not be excluded merely because its system name ends in ID.
Native record Id is not a substitute for Source System + External ID, Part + External ID, Source System + Code/Value, Part + Supplier, or local Role.Code uniqueness.

All returned object and field ValidationRules collections are empty. Default forms nevertheless declare unconditional mandatory inputs; no conditional, same-source, Revision.Part or composite-key enforcement is evidenced. Empty validation arrays do not prove that receive-service checks or database constraints are absent.

Product Family External ID is optional for standalone native-identity creation but required for nested descriptor resolution; it can be populated once then becomes immutable. Unconditional IsRequired=false alone is acceptable.
Product Family Raw Payload is required only for standalone family receives. Unconditional IsRequired=false alone is acceptable.
Engineering Change Scope.Part is required when Revision is populated; enforce Revision.Part=Part. It is not unconditionally required.

Engineering Change Scope identity uses six fields with null equality. The returned native primary-key metadata and empty ValidationRules do not establish enforcement of that provisional composite key.
Part Supplier Relationship key is Part + Supplier; optional Role is not a key component and replay must not create a duplicate unassigned membership.
unverifiedFromThisProjection: Text limits and decimal precision/scale are absent from these base projections; absence or null does not imply unlimited capacity or a match.
Notes/Description/Comment long-text capacity and complete Raw Payload 1 MiB UTF-8 capacity/binding remain unverified.
Type.Id establishes reference target identity; multiplicity, exact reverse pairing, relation storage and generated component filters need reference/relation metadata.
Default-form IsMandatory=true documents form requiredness for all39 present unconditional-required fields; it does not establish API/database persisted requiredness.

For59 present rows expected read-only on receiving screens, neither the base flag nor an explicit default-form override provides the restriction. Runtime rights, inherited control defaults and other screens remain unverified.
Field EditPermission and ViewPermission are null throughout the returned detailed projection; null does not mean public or unrestricted access. Effective security inheritance was not evaluated.
The Revisions grid has no filter/condition declared in Content. The required latest-feed default filter is not evidenced; generated grid component metadata and runtime results were not inspected.
The three conditional-requiredness cases have optional default controls and no returned conditional validation declarations. Receive-service enforcement remains unverified.
State-based or locale-based immutability/editability remains unverified for Family.External ID, Role.Code, Part Flag.Name and inactive Part Supplier Relationship.Role.
Uniqueness/index definitions, receive-service validation, native defaults, partial-update behavior, retention and transaction behavior are outside the inspected evidence.
